import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[20][20];
    static Queue<int[]> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static int[][] distFromZ = new int[20][20];
    static int[][][][] distABCD = new int[11][11][11][11];

    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, flow, cap, next;
        Edge(int f, int t, int fl, int c, int nx) {
            from = f; to = t; flow = fl; cap = c; next = nx;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[200005];
    static int edgeCount = 0;
    static int[] head = new int[505];
    static int[] parent = new int[505];
    static int[] visited = new int[505];
    static int source = 501, sink = 502, totalFlow = 0;
    static int n, t, depth[] = new int[505];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        edges[++edgeCount] = new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity, head[u]);
        head[u] = edgeCount;
        edges[++edgeCount] = new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edgeCount;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
        Arrays.fill(depth, 0);
        q.offer(source);
        visited[source] = 1;
        depth[source] = 1;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                if (visited[v] == 0 && edges[i].flow < edges[i].cap) {
                    parent[v] = i;
                    q.offer(v);
                    visited[v] = 1;
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flowLimit) {
        if (u == sink || flowLimit == 0) return flowLimit;
        int pushed = flowLimit;

        for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            int v = edges[i].to;
            if (edges[i].cap > edges[i].flow && depth[v] == depth[u] + 1) {
                int delta = dfs(v, Math.min(pushed, edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow));
                if (delta == 0) depth[v] = 0;
                edges[i].flow += delta;
                edges[((i - 1) ^ 1) + 1].flow -= delta;
                pushed -= delta;
                if (pushed == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return flowLimit - pushed;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (bfs()) {
            totalFlow += dfs(source, 1000000007);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize distances
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                distFromZ[i][j] = 10000;
                gridA[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    distFromZ[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) {
                    addEdge(source, (i - 1) * n + j, gridA[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // Multi-source BFS from Z cells
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfsQueue.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && Character.isDigit(gridA[nx][ny]) && distFromZ[nx][ny] > distFromZ[x][y] + 1) {
                    distFromZ[nx][ny] = distFromZ[x][y] + 1;
                    bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute pairwise distances between digit cells
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (!Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j])) continue;

                // Reset distance array for this source
                for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) {
                    for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
                        distABCD[i][j][a][b] = 10000;
                    }
                }

                bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                distABCD[i][j][i][j] = 0;

                while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cell = bfsQueue.poll();
                    int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                        if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && Character.isDigit(gridA[nx][ny]) &&
                                distABCD[i][j][nx][ny] > distABCD[i][j][x][y] + 1 &&
                                distABCD[i][j][x][y] < distFromZ[x][y]) {
                            distABCD[i][j][nx][ny] = distABCD[i][j][x][y] + 1;
                            bfsQueue.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Add edges based on distance constraints
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        if (distABCD[i][j][k][l] <= Math.min(distFromZ[k][l], t)) {
                            addEdge((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Read gridB and connect to sink
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB[i][j])) {
                    addEdge((i - 1) * n + j + 100, sink, gridB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        dinic();
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
